description: Synchronously move sites toward bounded Voronoi centroids.

behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee.
behavior.environment: No ambient RNG, noise, clock, renderer, assets or retained state. All geometry uses caller coordinates; p5 examples use their own canvas convention. Randomness, where present, is explicit input/output rngState.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input: sites (xy array), bounds (existing Voronoi bounds schema), iterations
(nonnegative integer), strength ([0,1]), maxWork. Output: {sites}. This compound
operation must call existing voronoiCells2D each pass, preserving one output
site per source index. Zero passes copies input, still validating all sites and
bounds according to Voronoi's domains. For nonempty polygon, compute signed-area
centroid by shoelace: Cx=sum((xi+xj)*cross)/(3*sum(cross)), likewise y. Empty or
zero-area cells leave the site unchanged. Replace each coordinate by
old+strength*(centroid-old); strength0 returns exact old coordinate after cell
work, strength1 exact centroid. Every pass is synchronous from prior sites.
No random jitter or duplicate-site repair. Output cell generation remains a
substitution point: caller can use final sites in the existing Voronoi operation.

Budget: reserve N+iterations first (safe arithmetic), then for iterations>0 let
passBudget=floor((maxWork-N-iterations)/iterations). Each Voronoi call receives
floor(passBudget/2); the other half is a separate centroid allowance. Charge one
centroid unit per returned polygon vertex and one per site update, including
empty cells. Insufficient allowance throws WORK_LIMIT; unused allowances are
not transferred between phases or passes. Zero iterations only requires N and
returns copied sites; empty input may return immediately after budget validation.
This deliberately conservative composition does not guess the child operation's
actual spent work. Validate finite sites and ordered finite bounds independently
before the zero-pass early return. Bounds match the Voronoi array schema.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export lloydRelaxation2D(input) from packages/javascript/src/lloyd-relaxation-2d.js. Other targets deferred.
